source.author: verg
source.text: Inde, ubi clara dedit sonitum tuba, finibus omnes, haud mora, prosiluere suis; ferit aethera clamor nauticus, adductis spumant freta versa lacertis.
source.text_original: Inde, ubi clara dedit sonitum tuba, finibus omnes, / haud mora, prosiluere suis; ferit aethera clamor / nauticus, adductis spumant freta versa lacertis.
source.text_english: Then, when the bright trumpet gave its sound, all without delay sprang forth from their own boundaries; a seamen’s shout strikes the sky, and the inverted seas foam with arms drawn back.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: non clamor anhelis nauticus aut blandus testudine defuit Orpheus.
reuse.text_original: non clamor anhelis / nauticus aut blandus testudine defuit Orpheus.
reuse.text_english: there was no sailor’s shout to the breathless, nor did Orpheus, with his lyre, fail to soothe them.
